get_idea_feedback.overview:
### Overview

Welcome to the Center! Your idea for a verified student carpooling app is a fantastic starting point. Tackling late-night transport in Kigali is a real, tangible challenge that many of your peers face daily. By focusing exclusively on university students, you are building in a crucial layer of trust that makes this stand out from standard ride-hailing apps.

### Key Insights

- Explore how the university ID verification process could work securely.
- Consider what incentives might encourage students who own cars to participate.
- Look into specific campus locations where late-night study is most common to map initial routes.
